laterChanges.event: Second Plenum communiqué (二十届二中全会, 2023-02-26 to 28): no expulsions, no vacancy filling. Attendance line records 候补中央委员170人. Personnel content limited to state/CPPCC leadership nominations and the 党和国家机构改革方案.

Politburo meeting adopted the CMC report on 李尚福 and decided to expel him from the Party (开除党籍) and terminate his 20th Congress delegate status; the CMC had earlier expelled him from the military and cancelled his 陆军上将 rank; expulsion 'to be confirmed at a plenum'. (Xinhua item on 李尚福 fetched; the companion 李玉超 item was not fetched — his expulsion is documented in the Third Plenum communiqué.)

Third Plenum communiqué: '全会审议并通过了中共中央军事委员会关于李尚福、李玉超、孙金明严重违纪违法问题的审查报告，确认中央政治局之前作出的给予李尚福、李玉超、孙金明开除党籍的处分' (李尚福, 李玉超 full members; 孙金明 alternate #49). Vacancies filled: '决定递补中央委员会候补委员丁向群、于立军、于吉红为中央委员会委员' (ordinals #1, #3, #4). Passed over: 丁兴农 (#2, 火箭军副政委, the highest-ranked military alternate). Also accepted 秦刚's resignation (civilian).

Party Centre decision (announced 2025-10-17 by the MND; read here in the 解放军报社论 carried by Xinhua 2025-10-18): '党中央决定，给予何卫东、苗华、何宏军、王秀斌、林向阳、秦树桐、袁华智、王厚斌、王春宁等9人开除党籍处分，将涉嫌犯罪问题移送军事检察机关依法审查起诉'. Eight of the nine are 20th CC full members; 王厚斌 (火箭军司令员) is not a CC member.

Fourth Plenum communiqué: adopted the CMC report on 何卫东、苗华、何宏军、王秀斌、林向阳、秦树桐、袁华智、王春宁、张凤中 and confirmed the Politburo's expulsions of those nine military members (eight full members plus alternate 张凤中 #83) together with civilians 唐仁健、金湘军、李石松、杨发森、朱芝松. Vacancies filled: '决定递补中央委员会候补委员于会文、马汉成、王健、王曦、王永红、王庭凯、王新伟、韦韬、邓亦武、邓修明、卢红为中央委员会委员' (ordinals #5, #6, #7, #8, #10, #12, #13, #15, #18, #19, #22). Military alternates ranked above #22 and passed over: 丁兴农 (#2), 王立岩 (#9), 王抗平 (#11), 方永祥 (#16), 石正露 (#21); civilians passed over in the same range: 王嘉毅 (#14), 方红卫 (#17), 石玉钢 (#20).
NPC Standing Committee 18th session (state, not Party, action): '决定任命张升民为中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席，免去何卫东的中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席职务'.

MND notice: '中央政治局委员、中央军委副主席张又侠，中央军委委员、中央军委联合参谋部参谋长刘振立涉嫌严重违纪违法，经党中央研究，决定对张又侠、刘振立立案审查调查'. No plenum action yet; the Fifth Plenum is scheduled for October 2026 (zh.wikipedia 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会 citing 12371.cn, 2026-08-01).

No plenum between the Fourth Plenum (2025-10-23) and the 2026-09-03 cutoff: the Politburo expulsion of 马兴瑞 (civilian, 2026-07-14, Xinhua) explicitly awaits plenum confirmation, and the Wikipedia CC20 article dates the Fifth Plenum to October 2026. Expulsions of civilians 蓝天立, 王莉霞, 易会满, 马兴瑞 (2026) are therefore pending and outside this lane.
